members.name: G0A.CAP
members.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: upper-case the first letter of a non-empty String

members.name: G0B.CAP
members.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT C 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN
members.note: capitalize one word

members.name: G1A.CAPWORD
members.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: a non-empty String with its first character upper-cased

members.name: G1B.CAP
members.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT C 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN
members.note: capitalize the first letter of one word

members.name: G2A.CAP
members.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: upper-case the first letter of a non-empty String

members.name: G2B.CAP
members.body: 'W' BIND W CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 C 0 GET UPPER PUT JOIN
members.note: upper-case the first letter of a non-empty word String

members.name: R1A.CAPWORD
members.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: a word with its first letter upper-cased

members.name: R1B.CAP
members.body: 'W' BIND W CHARS 0 GET UPPER W CHARS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: Capitalize the first letter of a word (String).

members.name: R1C.CAPWORD
members.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT C 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN
members.note: Upper-cases the first character of a String and keeps the rest unchanged.

members.name: R2A.CAP
members.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: String with its first letter upper-cased

members.name: R2C.CAP
members.body: 'W' BIND W CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT C 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN
members.note: Upper-cases the first letter of one word and keeps the rest.

members.name: S0A.CAP
members.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: upper-case the first letter of a non-empty String

members.name: S0B.CAP1
members.body: CHARS 'CS' BIND CS 0 GET UPPER CS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: Upper-case the first letter of a word.

members.name: S0C.CAPW
members.body: 'W' BIND W CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: Upper-cases the first character of one String and keeps the rest.

members.name: G0A.ABS
members.body: 'X' BIND X 0 X SUB MAX
members.note: absolute value, lifts over Vectors

members.name: G0B.ABS
members.body: 'D' BIND D D -1 MUL MAX
members.note: absolute value, lifts over vectors

members.name: G1A.ABS
members.body: 'X' BIND X 0 X SUB MAX
members.note: absolute value, element-wise over a Vector

members.name: G1B.ABSV
members.body: 'D' BIND D D -1 MUL MAX
members.note: elementwise absolute value of a numeric Vector

members.name: G1C.ABS
members.body: 'D' BIND D D -1 MUL MAX
members.note: absolute value of each element of a numeric Vector, element-wise

members.name: G2A.ABS
members.body: 'X' BIND X 0 X SUB MAX
members.note: absolute value, element-wise

members.name: G2C.ABS
members.body: 'X' BIND X 0 X SUB MAX
members.note: absolute value of a number, or element-wise over a numeric Vector

members.name: R1A.ABS
members.body: 'X' BIND X 0 X SUB MAX
members.note: absolute value, element-wise over a Vector

members.name: R1C.ABS
members.body: 'D' BIND D D -1 MUL MAX
members.note: Element-wise absolute value of a Vector, as the larger of x and -x.

members.name: R2A.ABS
members.body: 'X' BIND X 0 X SUB MAX
members.note: absolute value of a number (lifts over a Vector)

members.name: R2C.ABS
members.body: 'X' BIND X 0 X SUB MAX
members.note: Element-wise absolute value: the larger of X and its negation.

members.name: S0A.ABS
members.body: 'X' BIND X X -1 MUL MAX
members.note: absolute value, lane by lane over a number or Vector

members.name: S0C.ABS
members.body: 2 POW SQRT
members.note: Absolute value of an exact number, via its square root.

members.name: G0A.MAD
members.body: 'X' BIND X X G0A.MEDIAN SUB G0A.ABS G0A.MEDIAN
members.note: median absolute deviation from the median

members.name: G1A.MAD
members.body: 'V' BIND V V G0A.MEDIAN SUB G1A.ABS G0A.MEDIAN
members.note: median absolute deviation of a non-empty numeric Vector

members.name: G1B.MAD
members.body: 'V' BIND V G0A.MEDIAN 'M' BIND V M SUB G1B.ABSV G0A.MEDIAN
members.note: median absolute deviation of a numeric Vector

members.name: G2A.MAD
members.body: 'V' BIND V V G0A.MEDIAN SUB G2A.ABS G0A.MEDIAN
members.note: median absolute deviation of a non-empty numeric Vector

members.name: R1A.MAD
members.body: 'V' BIND V V X1.FIROSO SUB R1A.ABS X1.FIROSO
members.note: median absolute deviation of a numeric Vector

members.name: R2A.MAD
members.body: 'V' BIND V V X2.ZILOLE SUB R2A.ABS X2.ZILOLE
members.note: median absolute deviation of a numeric Vector

members.name: S0A.MAD
members.body: 'V' BIND V V S0A.MEDIAN SUB S0A.ABS S0A.MEDIAN
members.note: median absolute deviation from the median

members.name: G0A.MOVING3
members.body: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
members.note: means of every three consecutive numbers

members.name: G1A.MOVING3
members.body: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
members.note: means of every three consecutive numbers of a Vector (length >= 3)

members.name: G1B.MOVING3
members.body: 'V' BIND V LENGTH 2 SUB 'K' BIND V K TAKE V 1 DROP K TAKE ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
members.note: means of every three consecutive numbers

members.name: G2A.MOVING3
members.body: 'V' BIND V LENGTH 2 SUB 'N' BIND V N TAKE V 1 DROP N TAKE ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
members.note: means of every three consecutive numbers (length >= 3)

members.name: R1A.MOVING3
members.body: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
members.note: means of every three consecutive numbers

members.name: R2A.MOVING3
members.body: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
members.note: means of every three consecutive numbers

members.name: S0A.MOVING3
members.body: 'V' BIND V LENGTH 2 SUB 'N' BIND V N TAKE V 1 DROP N TAKE ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
members.note: means of every three consecutive numbers

members.name: G0A.RUNMAX

members.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
members.note: running maximum of a numeric Vector

members.note: running maximum of a numeric Vector

members.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
members.note: running maximum of a numeric Vector

members.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
members.note: running maximum, one lane per input lane

members.name: G0A.MODE
members.body: SORT TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES G0A.ARGMAX GET
members.note: most frequent number, smallest on ties

members.name: G1A.MODE
members.body: SORT TALLY G0B.TOPKEY
members.note: most frequent element of a Vector; smallest on ties

members.name: G1B.MODE
members.body: SORT TALLY G0B.TOPKEY
members.note: most frequent number, smallest on ties

members.name: G2A.MODE
members.body: SORT TALLY G0B.TOPKEY
members.note: most frequent element; smallest on ties

members.name: R1A.MODE
members.body: SORT TALLY X1.NILUGA
members.note: most frequent number, smallest on ties

members.name: R2A.MODE
members.body: SORT TALLY X2.PIDOZE
members.note: most frequent element, smallest on ties

members.name: S0A.MODE
members.body: SORT S0A.MOST-FREQ
members.note: most frequent number; ties go to the smallest

members.name: G0B.JOINSP
members.body: [ 'X' BIND ' ' X 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
members.note: join a Vector of words with single spaces

members.name: G1A.LONGEST
members.body: 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
members.note: longest String in a Vector of Strings; first on ties

members.name: G2A.LONGEST
members.body: 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
members.note: longest String in a Vector; first on ties

members.name: R1A.ARGMAX-BY-LEN
members.body: 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP X1.PIMAPA GET
members.note: longest String in a Vector, first on ties

members.name: S0A.JOIN-SP
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT ] MAP FLATTEN -1 DROP JOIN
members.note: join a non-empty Vector of Strings with single spaces

members.name: S0B.SPJOIN
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT ] MAP FLATTEN JOIN TRIM
members.note: Join a Vector of Strings with single spaces.

members.name: S0C.SPJOIN
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT ] MAP FLATTEN JOIN TRIM
members.note: Joins a Vector of Strings into one String separated by single spaces.

members.name: G0A.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'V' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND V N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET G0A.MEAN
members.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector

members.name: X1.FIROSO
members.body: SORT 'V' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND V N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET X1.GISUZU

members.name: X2.ZILOLE
members.body: SORT 'V' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND V N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET X2.NEGEKE

members.name: G0B.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET G0B.MEAN
members.note: median of a Vector

members.name: G0C.MEDIAN
members.body: 'MDV' BIND MDV SORT 'MDS' BIND MDV LENGTH 'MDN' BIND MDS MDN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MDS MDN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: Median of a numeric Vector: mean of the two middle sorted values (one value twice when the count is odd).

members.name: S0A.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET S0A.MEAN
members.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers

members.name: S0B.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'XS' BIND XS LENGTH 'LN' BIND XS LN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET XS LN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: Median of a Vector of numbers.

members.name: S0C.MEDIAN
members.body: 'V' BIND V SORT 'S' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: Median of a Vector of exact numbers (mean of the two middle values when the count is even).

members.name: G0A.TRIMMED
members.body: SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP G0A.MEAN
members.note: mean after dropping one smallest and one largest

members.name: G1A.TRIMMED
members.body: SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP G0A.MEAN
members.note: mean after removing one smallest and one largest number

members.name: G1B.TRIMMED
members.body: SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP G0A.MEAN
members.note: mean after dropping one min and one max

members.name: G2A.TRIMMED
members.body: SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP G0A.MEAN
members.note: mean after dropping one smallest and one largest

members.name: R1A.TRIMMED
members.body: SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP X1.GISUZU
members.note: mean after dropping one smallest and one largest

members.name: S0A.TRIMMED
members.body: SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP S0A.MEAN
members.note: mean after dropping one smallest and one largest

members.name: G0A.SUM
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: sum of a numeric Vector (0 for empty)

members.name: X1.RUKUTA
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD

members.name: X2.TUZIGA
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD

members.name: G0B.SUM
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: sum of a Vector

members.name: S0A.SUM
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for empty)

members.name: S0B.SUM
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: Sum of a Vector.

members.name: G0A.MEAN
members.body: 'V' BIND V G0A.SUM V LENGTH DIV
members.note: arithmetic mean of a numeric Vector

members.name: X1.GISUZU
members.body: 'V' BIND V X1.RUKUTA V LENGTH DIV

members.name: X2.NEGEKE
members.body: 'V' BIND V X2.TUZIGA V LENGTH DIV

members.name: G0B.MEAN
members.body: 'V' BIND V G0B.SUM V LENGTH DIV
members.note: mean of a Vector

members.name: S0A.MEAN
members.body: 'V' BIND V S0A.SUM V LENGTH DIV
members.note: arithmetic mean of a non-empty Vector of numbers

members.name: G1B.DEBTORS
members.body: G0A.BYNAME 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
members.note: names whose summed amounts are negative

members.name: G2A.DEBTORS
members.body: G0A.BYNAME G2A.PAIRS [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
members.note: names whose ledger amounts sum below zero, first-appearance order

members.name: R1A.DEBTORS
members.body: X1.RIVINO 'R' BIND R KEYS [ 'K' BIND R K GET 0 LT ] FILTER
members.note: names whose ledger amounts sum below zero, in first-appearance order

members.name: G0A.WORDS
members.body: ' ' TOKENIZE
members.note: split a String on single spaces into a Vector of words

members.name: X1.VIDIKO
members.body: ' ' TOKENIZE

members.name: X2.VIVIKA
members.body: ' ' TOKENIZE

members.name: S0A.WORDS
members.body: ' ' TOKENIZE
members.note: split a String at single spaces into words

members.name: G0B.BYNAME
members.body: ZIP 'Z' BIND Z 0 GET Z 1 GET GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: ledger entries to Record name->sum

members.name: S0A.BY-NAME
members.body: S0A.LEDGER-SPLIT GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ S0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: ledger -> Record name -> summed amount, first-appearance order

members.name: G0C.SUMS
members.body: 'LE' BIND LE [ 0 GET ] MAP 'LN' BIND LE [ 1 GET ] MAP 'LA' BIND LN LA GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
members.note: Ledger entries [name amount] to a Record from name to its summed amount, names in first-appearance order.

members.name: S0B.SUMS
members.body: 'E' BIND E [ 0 GET ] MAP E [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES [ S0B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: Record name -> sum of amounts from a Vector of [name amount] entries.

members.name: G1A.INITIALS
members.body: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
members.note: upper-case initials of words longer than three letters ('' if none)

members.name: R1A.INITIALS
members.body: X1.VIDIKO [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
members.note: upper-case initials of the words longer than three letters in a text

members.name: G1A.KEYSWHERE
members.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
members.note: keys of a Record whose numeric value is below zero, in key order

members.name: R2A.NEGKEYS
members.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
members.note: keys of a Record whose values are below zero, in key order

members.name: G1A.LARGEST
members.body: 'E' BIND E E G1A.AMOUNTS G0A.ARGMAX GET
members.note: [ name amount ] entry with the largest amount; first on ties

members.name: G1B.LARGEST
members.body: 'V' BIND V V ZIP 1 GET G0A.ARGMAX GET
members.note: entry with the largest amount, first on ties

members.name: G1B.LONGEST
members.body: G0A.WORDS 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
members.note: longest word of a String, first on ties

members.name: S0A.LONGEST
members.body: S0A.WORDS 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP S0A.ARGMAX
members.note: longest word of a text, first of ties
